review.why: Researches into a knowledge base: scan existing notes, agree a rubric, preserve sources verbatim, write a cited draft.
review.summary: Eight gated steps: create task checkpoints, scan what the knowledge base already covers, agree a research rubric with the user, capture each source verbatim as it is fetched, analyze, write a draft article section by section, link it into the graph and validate. Findings stay provisional until a later step promotes them.
strengths: Saves each source and each finding as it goes, so a crash loses nothing
Missing evidence is never invented: it asks the user to paste it
Checks existing coverage first and extends instead of duplicating
cautions: Built for one knowledge-base platform: needs its MCP server, tools and an ingest procedure kept in another file
Heavy ceremony for a small question
Promoting findings to final notes belongs to a separate skill
